title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics.
Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs in 5.1 innings, leading to the Athletics' lead.
Despite out-hitting, the Red Sox left the bases loaded and struck out 15 times, ending their comeback attempt.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf due to an NFL procedural rule requiring specific laboratory testing protocols.
The new turf will be installed before the Patriots' preseason game, replacing a recently installed post-World Cup surface.
The turf change is due to Gillette Stadium's lack of an 'E-layer,' causing non-compliance with NFL lab testing standards.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, marking a disappointing debut for Jack Harrison.
Revolution's defense struggled, with Guilherme capitalizing on poor defensive discipline to score Houston's first goal.
Houston's Agustin Resch secured the victory with a second goal off a corner kick, despite Revolution's late attempts.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony begins hitting off a pitching machine, aiming for a late-season return from a wrist injury.
Adley Rutschman made his rehab debut with the Worcester Red Sox, catching five innings and throwing out a runner.
Both Anthony and Rutschman are expected to bolster the Red Sox lineup, currently on a 9-game winning streak.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless' (1995) is streaming on Netflix, featuring Alicia Silverstone and based on Jane Austen's 'Emma'.
'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' (2026) launches on Paramount+, continuing the story of the iconic Nickelodeon series.
Season 4 of 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' debuts on Paramount+, thrilling fans with time travel and philosophical themes.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an eight-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, on July 5, verified by BFRO.
New England has had 126 verified Bigfoot sightings since 1994, according to the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Experts remain skeptical, noting no scientific evidence exists for Bigfoot, despite numerous anecdotal reports and expeditions.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Meredith Goldstein reflects on her friendship with Margo Howard, who passed away at age 86.
Margo Howard, daughter of advice columnist Ann Landers, was known for her practical and empathetic advice.
Goldstein credits Howard with teaching her to find happiness after loss and avoid being stuck in past misery.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out 14 batters in six innings, leading the Red Sox to a 13-1 victory over the Athletics.
Red Sox extend winning streak to nine games, improving their record to 64-51, after defeating the Athletics.
Boston Red Sox bats amassed 15 hits, including five-run second inning, to overpower the Athletics at Fenway.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez engage in competitive matchups during Patriots training camp to improve their skills.
Gonzalez uses intentional trash talk against Brown to simulate challenges from other NFL star corners through the season.
Gonzalez is participating in training camp amid contract negotiations, while Brown prepares for a bounce-back year with Drake Maye.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman begins rehab assignment Saturday with the Triple-A Worcester Red Sox for left wrist inflammation.
Rutschman was acquired from the Orioles in exchange for three prospects and catcher Carlos Narvaez on Monday.
Rutschman is expected to catch five innings and have two or three at-bats in his rehab game.
